arguments.value: Adrienne Camille Nelson, born in 1967 in Kansas City, Missouri, has served as a United States District Judge for the District of Oregon since her confirmation in 2023. She earned her B.A. from the University of Arkansas in 1989 and her J.D. from the University of Texas School of Law in 1993. Nelson began her legal career as an attorney with Multnomah Defenders, Inc. in Portland and later entered private practice, also serving as an adjunct professor at Lewis & Clark Law School and as coordinator and senior attorney at Portland State University. She was elected to the Oregon Circuit Court for Multnomah County in 2006, served there until 2018, and then served as an associate justice on the Oregon Supreme Court from 2018 to 2023 before her appointment to the federal bench.
